description_en: Retrieves the tag values that correspond to a specified tag key from the reported trace data
description_zh: 获取上报的链路数据中指定Tag Key对应的Tag Value
kebab_example: aliyun xtrace get-tag-val --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag-key span.kind --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetTagVal

parameters.help_en: The service name, also known as the application name
parameters.help_zh: 服务名称，又称为应用名称
parameters.name: service_name

parameters.help_en: The span name, also known as the operation name
parameters.name: span_name

parameters.help_en:
The tag key.

To obtain the tag key, call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2399667.html
parameters.name: tag_key

parameters.help_en:
The start time. Unit: milliseconds (ms).
<notice>The value of this field is of the Long type. Precision may be lost during sequence/desequence. Ensure that the value is not greater than 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
开始时间，精确到毫秒（ms）。
<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end time. Unit: milliseconds (ms).
<notice>The value of this field is of the Long type. Precision may be lost during sequence/desequence. Ensure that the value is not greater than 9007199254740991.></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
结束时间，精确到毫秒（ms）。
<notice>该字段类型为 Long，在序列化/反序列化的过程中可能导致精度丢失，请注意数值不得大于 9007199254740991。></notice>
parameters.name: end_time
